## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Behavior matches the referenced contract, including failure/lifecycle cases.
- [ ] Applicable tests and performance measurements are recorded.
- [ ] Required hardware/platform evidence is linked, or the validation blocker remains open.

## Validation and handoff

Record exact commands/results, fixture and artifact hashes, remaining blockers and the next action. Do not include private device identifiers or credentials.
